description: Fetch a public web page and return its readable content as JSON: plain text or Markdown (headings, lists, links kept), plus title, description, author, publish date, site name, language and preview image. Ads, menus and scripts are stripped. Also reads PDF, Word, Excel and CSV links. Failed fetches are not charged. Price: $0.002 USDC (x402).

format.description: markdown (default here: keeps headings, lists and links) or text

url.description: Public http(s) page or document to read

name: read_page
